# Lava blobs bobbing in the pool: four crusted blobs (one bone each), each rises out of the lava and
# sinks back in a 2 s loop, offset by a quarter loop from the next. Pool centre at the origin; its
# surface is 0.12 below the island top. Generated by make_env.py.
new
fps 12
frame range 0 24
material new Blob --base-color 0.773 0.227 0.616 --emission 0.773 0.227 0.616 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Blob0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0.25 0.15 -0.12
scale 1 1 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Blob
add mesh ico-sphere --name Blob1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.13 --location -0.3 0.2 -0.12
scale 1 1 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Blob
add mesh ico-sphere --name Blob2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.14 --location 0.05 -0.35 -0.12
scale 1 1 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Blob
add mesh ico-sphere --name Blob3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.11 --location -0.2 -0.1 -0.12
scale 1 1 0.8
apply --scale
material assign Blob
select Blob0
frame set 0
set location 0.25 0.15 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 6
set location 0.25 0.15 -0.06
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 12
set location 0.25 0.15 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 18
set location 0.25 0.15 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 24
set location 0.25 0.15 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
select Blob1
frame set 0
set location -0.3 0.2 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 6
set location -0.3 0.2 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 12
set location -0.3 0.2 -0.06
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 18
set location -0.3 0.2 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 24
set location -0.3 0.2 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
select Blob2
frame set 0
set location 0.05 -0.35 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 6
set location 0.05 -0.35 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 12
set location 0.05 -0.35 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 18
set location 0.05 -0.35 -0.06
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 24
set location 0.05 -0.35 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
select Blob3
frame set 0
set location -0.2 -0.1 -0.06
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 6
set location -0.2 -0.1 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 12
set location -0.2 -0.1 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 18
set location -0.2 -0.1 -0.30
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 24
set location -0.2 -0.1 -0.06
keyframe insert --channels loc
frame set 0
select all
shade flat
export blobs.glb --bake-animations
